aggregator.explanation: Lesson 1 is the overall winner. The strongest substantive dimensions favor it: visual accuracy (0.82) and concept accuracy (0.78) both indicate that Lesson 1 preserves the correct optimization setup, equations, derivative, and result, while Lesson 2 lacks adequate teaching content and includes misleading visual representations. Sync also slightly favors Lesson 1 (0.55) because it at least has narration to evaluate, whereas Lesson 2 has essentially none. Lesson 2 does win narration quality (0.55) and polish (0.78), mainly because Lesson 1 is garbled and visually cluttered, but those advantages are outweighed by Lesson 1’s stronger mathematical and instructional correctness. Interactivity is a tie because neither lesson shows functioning checkpoints. Overall, the weighted verdicts clearly lean toward Lesson 1, though confidence is only moderate due to Lesson 1’s serious narration and polish issues.
